extracted.name: Ultimate Shrimp Scampi
extracted.description: This ultimate shrimp scampi recipe features angel hair pasta in an easy garlic, lemon, and white wine sauce topped with Asiago cheese and avocado.
ingredient_lines: 1 pound peeled and deveined medium shrimp
1 large avocado - peeled, pitted and diced
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook pasta in boiling water until tender yet firm to the bite, 2 to 3 minutes; drain.

Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat. Add onion, lemon juice, garlic, parsley, white wine, salt, pepper, and Worcestershire sauce; cook and stir until mixture bubbles. Increase heat to medium-high and stir in shrimp. Cook and stir until shrimp turn pink and opaque, about 5 minutes.
Serve shrimp scampi over pasta. Sprinkle with Asiago cheese and avocado to serve.
